From 63f2b1677fba11c5bd02089f25c13421948905f5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Noralf=20Tr=C3=B8nnes?= <noralf@tronnes.org>
Date: Tue, 17 Sep 2019 19:18:41 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] staging/fbtft: Depend on OF
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit c440eee1a7a1 ("Staging: fbtft: Switch to the gpio descriptor
interface") removed setting gpios via platform data. This means that
fbtft will now only work with Device Tree so set the dependency.

This also prevents a NULL pointer deref on non-DT platform because
fbtftops.request_gpios is not set in that case anymore.

Fixes: c440eee1a7a1 ("Staging: fbtft: Switch to the gpio descriptor interface")
Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Noralf Trønnes <noralf@tronnes.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20190917171843.10334-1-noralf@tronnes.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/staging/fbtft/Kconfig b/drivers/staging/fbtft/Kconfig
index 8ec524a95ec8..4e5d860fd788 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/fbtft/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/staging/fbtft/Kconfig
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0
 menuconfig FB_TFT
 	tristate "Support for small TFT LCD display modules"
-	depends on FB && SPI
+	depends on FB && SPI && OF
 	depends on GPIOLIB || COMPILE_TEST
 	select FB_SYS_FILLRECT
 	select FB_SYS_COPYAREA
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/staging/fbtft/Kconfig`**
   - The dependency line for the `FB_TFT` configuration option was modified. 
   - Changed from:
     ```plaintext
     depends on FB && SPI
     ```
     to:
     ```plaintext
     depends on FB && SPI && OF
     ```

### Relationships

- The modification in the `Kconfig` file establishes a new dependency on the Open Firmware (OF) framework for the `FB_TFT` driver. This change is necessary because the previous commit (c440eee1a7a1) removed the ability to set GPIOs via platform data, meaning that the driver now exclusively relies on Device Tree configurations. By adding the `OF` dependency, the patch ensures that the driver will not be used in non-Device Tree environments, thus preventing potential NULL pointer dereferences that could occur when the driver attempts to access GPIOs that are not set.

Commit c440eee1a7a1 ("Staging: fbtft: Switch to the gpio descriptor
interface") removed setting gpios via platform data. This means that
fbtft will now only work with Device Tree so set the dependency.

This also prevents a NULL pointer deref on non-DT platform because
fbtftops.request_gpios is not set in that case anymore.

Fixes: c440eee1a7a1 ("Staging: fbtft: Switch to the gpio descriptor interface")
Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Noralf Trønnes <noralf@tronnes.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20190917171843.10334-1-noralf@tronnes.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that the `fbtft` driver was modified to use the GPIO descriptor interface, which removed the ability to set GPIOs via platform data. As a result, the driver now relies solely on Device Tree configurations. If the driver is used in a non-Device Tree environment, it leads to a situation where `fbtftops.request_gpios` is not set, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the driver attempts to access GPIOs.

+	depends on FB && SPI && OF
 	depends on GPIOLIB || COMPILE_TEST

This change necessitates that the driver operates in a Device Tree (DT) environment. If the driver is used in a non-DT environment, `fbtftops.request_gpios` remains unset, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when the driver attempts to access GPIOs.

Reason:
By adding the dependency on `OF` (Open Firmware), the patch ensures that the `fbtft` driver will only be compiled and used in environments that support Device Tree.
